info.title: operator-orchestration-service API
info.summary: Bounded workflow broker API for idea intake and Workspace Delivery ART execution.
info.description:
Canonical API reference for the currently implemented operator-orchestration-service route surface. Workflow meaning stays in the repo operator docs; this spec is the route and payload reference layer.

## Reading This Front
- `/v1/...` routes are broker-shaped contracts, not raw OpenProject passthroughs.
- Most write routes carry mutable fields inside an `input` object.
- Idea capture and bounded idea decisions also carry an `operator` object so the broker can attribute the human action.
- Broker-shaped ids look like `idea-40`, `delivery-38`, and `work-item-177`.
- Caller-authenticated routes require both `x-oos-caller-id` and `x-oos-caller-secret`.

post.description: Accepts one strict, versioned request from the authenticated Governance Operations Console for an active definition. A new start returns a worker-independent admission receipt with the stable run id; callers read the aggregate projection from the run resource. The route rejects the generic development auth bypass and fails closed unless Platform runtime acceptance, fresh Security activation review, worker enablement, and execution authorization are all present.

requestBody.description: Frozen source intent, source version, approval, idempotency, and return-projection contract for one admitted run.

200.description: An idempotent duplicate resolved to the existing run. A running duplicate returns a null projection; a closed duplicate returns its retained terminal projection.

409.description: Definition activation gates are incomplete or the idempotency key conflicts with immutable request bindings.

503.description: Caller authentication is not configured, the admitted runtime is unavailable, or an existing run binding cannot be verified.

get.description: Queries the OOS-owned aggregate projection for one durable run on behalf of the Governance Operations Console. Runtime adapter details remain secondary diagnostics.

200.description: Aggregate run projection.

post.summary: Apply a bounded control to an existing run
post.description: Applies a Governance Operations Console retry, resume, cancel, or defer only when the aggregate run projection exposes that control as available. Cancel interrupts active work; retry and resume cannot bypass the manual-attempt limit. Definition-owned signal remains reserved and unavailable for this definition. A success response requires the retained projection to contain the complete immutable control binding. Close races and control-key conflicts return distinct actionable 409 responses.

requestBody.description: Versioned, attributed, idempotent run-control request.

200.description: Updated aggregate run projection.

409.description: Durable execution is not admitted, the control is unavailable, the run changed before the control was retained, or its keys identify a different immutable control binding.

controlNotApplied.summary: Run closed before the requested control was retained

value.message: The run changed before the requested control was applied. Review the retained state before retrying.

idempotencyConflict.summary: Control keys identify another immutable request

value.message: The control id or idempotency key already identifies a different immutable control request.

post.description: Updates bounded initiative-level governance fields without changing the child plan. Use it for epic status, assignee/responsible ownership, PM2 phase, sponsor, success criteria, or initiative-review evidence fields. PM2 Closing and final done transitions now fail closed unless the governed initiative-review conditions are already satisfied. Initiative retirement is also fail-closed: the epic may move to `retired` only after all descendants are already `done` or `retired`, and the broker clears the stored PM2 phase during that retirement transition.

requestBody.description: Send only the initiative governance fields you need to change. At least one field inside `input` must be present. When `assignee_login` or `responsible_login` is supplied, it must resolve from the live assignable-principal list for Workspace Delivery ART. `owner_repo` uses the same live form-backed owner metadata surface as child work-item writes. The same route also owns top-level initiative-lineage fields: `initiative_family`, `lineage_role`, `architecture_anchor_ref`, and `required_upstream_ref`.

post.description: Creates one child work item below an existing parent. Use this for bounded ART planning when a single new task, user story, defect, feature, or objective should be added with governance fields in the same write. `Enabler` and `Improvement` semantics now travel through `execution_classification` on `Feature` or `User story`, not through a structural `Enabler` type. Story-level elaboration belongs after PI commitment, so `PI Objective`, `User story`, `Task`, and `Milestone` work must carry `Target PI`, and `User story` or `Task` creation requires a PI-committed parent. Enter blocked status only through the dedicated blocker workflow after the item exists.

requestBody.description: Fill `input.parent_work_item_id`, `input.type`, and `input.subject` at minimum. Add `input.execution_classification` when the new `Feature` or `User story` is `Enabler` or `Improvement` work. Add `input.target_pi` and non-backlog `input.iteration` for PI-committed non-`Epic` work, and provide DoR/DoD fields when the new item should be ready immediately.

input.description:
## Outcome

Define the architecture and trust-boundary foundation.

## Why This PI

Implementation depends on stable architecture truth.

## Success Signal

Runtime features can consume the design without chat memory.

## Execution Context

- Owner Repo: workspace-governance
- Parent Item: #420 Build Workspace Governance Control Fabric foundation
- Delivery Team: Platform Architecture
- Iteration: PI-2026-03 / Iteration 1
input.subject: Define the control-fabric architecture foundation

200.description: Delivery work item was created below the supplied parent.

post.description: Applies the same bounded update surface to multiple work items in one request. Use this when a small coordinated set of items needs status, assignment, or governance changes together. Active non-Epic work still must carry `Target PI`, and PI-committed non-Epic work must keep a non-backlog `Iteration`.

requestBody.description: Provide `input.schema_version=1` and one or more update entries. Each entry must include the target work package id plus at least one bounded update field.

bulkAdvanceTwoItems.summary: Advance two work items into execution together

updates.work_note: Started the first broker cutover slice.

200.description: Bulk update results.

get.summary: Read continuation context for one work item
get.description: Returns the compact continuation packet for one work item. Use this before continuing ART work so parent chain, open siblings, previously completed related items, target execution classification, and enclosing initiative lineage are visible first.

200.description: Compact continuation packet for one ART work item.

get.summary: Read one compact work-item evidence packet
get.description: Returns the bounded evidence packet for one ART work item, including evidence formatting state, done-narrative state, continuation summary, parent chain, and completed related items without embedding raw descriptions or full initiative trees.

200.description: Compact evidence packet for one ART work item.

post.summary: Close one stale-open delivery work item
post.description: Closes one stale-open ART work item through a guarded broker workflow. The route verifies that the target item is still open, that all children are already terminal, and that the operator provided explicit stale-open justification before it reuses the normal completion-evidence path. When `WGCF_ART_READINESS_MODE=required`, the broker calls WGCF ART readiness before the OpenProject write and fails closed if WGCF blocks the mutation.

requestBody.description: Use the same completion evidence fields as normal completion and add `input.stale_open_justification` so the operator explicitly attests that completed child scope satisfies the parent item.

input.completion_summary: Closed the stale-open parent through one broker workflow.
input.stale_open_justification: Completed child scope already satisfies the parent read surface.
input.validation_evidence: - PASS: live stale-open closeout proof recorded.

200.description: Bounded stale-open closeout result for one work item.

post.description: Updates one existing work item through the broker-owned bounded field surface. Use this for status, PI, assignee, work-note, readiness, and governance-field changes without moving or completing the item. The broker also enforces planning discipline: active non-Epic work cannot stay uncommitted, story-level work cannot exist without `Target PI`, and PI-committed non-Epic work must keep a non-backlog `Iteration`. Entering or clearing blocked status is not part of the generic update surface; use the dedicated blocker workflow instead. If the resulting work item remains `done`, the broker revalidates the final stored body before patching OpenProject: completion-evidence formatting must still be valid, the stronger done-state narrative contract must still hold, and any broker-added work note must stay inside `Operator work notes`.

requestBody.description: Provide at least one mutable field inside `input`. Use the `clear_*` booleans only when you intend to remove an existing value rather than replace it.

startWorkItem.summary: Assign and start a work item

input.work_note: Move proof is running through the broker route.

requestBody.description: Set `input.action` first, then provide the blocker fields that match that action. For `set`, capture the blocker statement, impact, owners, dates, and decision path explicitly. For `clear`, resume only to `new`, `ready`, or `in-progress`.

post.summary: Complete one work item with evidence
post.description: Completes one work item only when the broker-formatted evidence sections and the stronger done-state narrative contract are satisfied. Use this after the local work is validated and committed so the ART record shows what changed and what proved completion. Run the local completion-evidence preflight before this write so malformed evidence fails before the broker call. When `WGCF_ART_READINESS_MODE=required`, the broker calls WGCF ART readiness before the OpenProject write and fails closed if WGCF blocks the mutation. The broker then validates the final stored body after any broker-added completion note, and that note must stay inside `Operator work notes` rather than leaking into evidence sections. Changed-surface bullets must explain what changed on each surface rather than listing bare paths or raw references.

requestBody.description: Fill the required completion sections exactly as evidence prose, not ad hoc fragments. `changed_surfaces`, `test_result_evidence`, and `validation_evidence` should already be operator-readable when posted. `changed_surfaces` bullets must explain what changed on each surface, code-format source paths, and use markdown links or URLs for PR references. The resulting done-state description must also keep the required narrative headings for the work-item type, and `Execution Context` must stay a flat bullet list aligned to the stored owner, parent, delivery-team, and iteration fields when they apply. `test_result_evidence` lines must start with `- PASS:`, `- FAIL:`, `- NOT APPLICABLE:`, or `- Attached artifact:`. `validation_evidence` lines must start with `- PASS:`, `- FAIL:`, `- CHECK:`, `- NOT APPLICABLE:`, or `- Attached artifact:`. If `completion_note` is present, the broker appends it inside `Operator work notes` and revalidates the final stored body before patching OpenProject.

completeWithEvidence.summary: Complete a work item with formatted evidence

- `docs/api/openapi.json`: documents the completion route contract.
- `docs/api/index.html`: publishes the generated API reference.
- `scripts/validate_api_docs.mjs`: validates the generated API documentation.

post.description: Creates an editable mutation draft for one supported ART write operation. The draft locks the intended broker route and payload shape before the operator edits the body, so the operator does not hand-build loose `.tmp` JSON payloads or accidentally target raw OpenProject routes.

200.description: Mutation draft validation result.

post.summary: Create a broker-owned mutation draft from a WGCF receipt
post.description: Imports workspace-governance-control-fabric receipt references, readiness recommendations, closeout draft hints, blocker recommendations, and Review Packet references into a managed OOS mutation draft. The route never submits the mutation; WGCF remains recommendation-only and OOS remains the ART mutation authority.

Use this after opening the PR and before merging it; use finalization only after merge.

example.cancellation_boundary: Operator cancellation sends the admitted cancel control and interrupts the active activity or waiting run.
